Confirm resume source is same_process
remediation_steps: Provide CalibrationMemoryCheckpointStore
Switch to execution_mode=disk for cross-process resume

Confirm disk checkpoint directory argument is set

Rerun from checkpoint or from start

triage_steps: Check in-memory store for run_id checkpoints
Confirm prior run emitted successful checkpoint metadata
remediation_steps: Run non-resume path to seed checkpoints
Retry same-process resume

triage_steps: Identify missing stage from failure payload
Check staged input payload map for that stage
remediation_steps: Provide missing stage input
Resume from last successful stage if possible

triage_steps: Confirm in-memory handoff route for failing stage edge
Confirm upstream stage executed in current process
remediation_steps: Run upstream stage in same process
Use persisted artifact handoff in disk mode when cross-process is required

triage_steps: Validate checkpoint URI format
Confirm stage token or last-success token is valid
remediation_steps: Correct checkpoint reference
Retry resume

triage_steps: Check checkpoint file existence at resolved location
Check file permissions and corruption status
remediation_steps: Restore or replace missing checkpoint artifact

triage_steps: Compare run_id, execution_mode, stage order, and schema versions
Confirm resume_from_stage belongs to execution order
remediation_steps: Use checkpoint from compatible run contract
Use same_process resume only for memory and persisted reference only for disk

triage_steps: Check checkpoint directory write permission and capacity
Check atomic rename behavior of target filesystem
remediation_steps: Fix filesystem permissions or storage limits
Resume from last successful checkpoint after fix

triage_steps: Inspect successful stage report metadata payload
Confirm seed and solver metadata are present
remediation_steps: Fix stage metadata emission contract
Re-run pipeline after patch

triage_steps: Inspect failing stage identifier
Inspect stage-specific failure payload inside stage reports
remediation_steps: Apply stage-specific remediation
Resume in memory mode via same_process or in disk mode via persisted checkpoint
